_note: Verses are kept exactly as they appeared in the original index.html (with tashkeel). The 'mutanabbi-stars' verse is from the original script.js. Two further verses attributed in script.js to Abu Firas al-Hamdani and Antarah ibn Shaddad could not be verified and are intentionally not published; see README.

hemistichs: عَلَى قَدْرِ أَهْلِ الْعَزْمِ تَأْتِي الْعَزَائِمُ
verses.translation: Resolutions arrive in proportion to the people of resolve, and noble deeds arrive in proportion to the noble.

hemistichs: مِنَ الْحُسْنِ حَتَّى كَادَ أَنْ يَتَكَلَّمَا
verses.translation: Radiant spring has come to you, strutting and laughing, so lovely it all but began to speak.

poet.ar: من شعر زهير بن أبي سلمى

hemistichs: وَمَنْ يَجْعَلِ المَعْرُوفَ فِي غَيْرِ أَهْلِهِ
verses.translation: Whoever places kindness where it does not belong will find his praise turned to blame, and will regret it.

note.ar: في الحكمة ووضع الأمور في نصابها
note.en: On wisdom and putting things in their proper place

verses.translation: If you venture toward a noble goal, do not settle for anything less than the stars.
